title: Analytically dense Mordell-Weil rank jumps on elliptic surfaces via transverse realization
summary: Let $\mathcal{W}_{\mathrm{min},n}$ be the moduli stack of minimal Weierstrass fibrations of Faltings height $n$ over an unparameterized $\mathbb{P}^1_{\mathbb{C}}$, and let $\mathcal{W}_n^{\mathrm{sb}}$ be its dense open substack of simply-branched surfaces with only ${\mathop{\rm I}}_1$ singular fibres.
